title: fagara affinis
intro: Fagara affinis, commonly known as Chinese prickly ash, is a plant species in the Rutaceae family that has been used in traditional medicine for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Fagara affinis include its ability to aid in digestion, relieve nausea, and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Fagara affinis include alkaloids, flavonoids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
